description: The closed list of strategy ids per axis. A dialect may only name ids listed here, and an implementation must implement exactly these - no more, no fewer. A new id needs an evidence case that reaches it (the growth rule); see corpus/README.md.

family.description: Which grammar parses an expression into fields.

domDow.description: How the day-of-month and day-of-week fields combine.

star.description: When a field counts as a star for the domDow rule and for telling fixed-time from wildcard schedules.

interval.description: How the dialect spells an interval schedule (every N seconds from an anchor), if it has one.

dstGap.description: What happens to a run whose wall time a spring-forward skipped.

dstOverlap.description: What happens to a run whose wall time a fall-back repeated.
